details:
Earth Jukebox – Exploring Earth's Changing Temperature

Earth Jukebox is an interactive website that helps users explore changes in Earth's global temperature over time. Users can select different years from a dropdown menu and see the corresponding temperature pattern, a changing visual representation of Earth, and a global temperature trend chart.

The project uses NASA GISS Surface Temperature Analysis (GISTEMP) global annual temperature anomaly data. The website reads the dataset and displays the temperature trend in degrees Celsius. The Earth visual changes its colour intensity according to the selected year's temperature anomaly, helping users understand warming patterns more easily.

The project was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in Visual Studio Code. It combines data visualization with an accessible, interactive website design to make climate information easier to explore and understand.

Our current version focuses on visualizing global temperature changes. It aims to make Earth science information more engaging and understandable for a wider audience.
